What We Offer

Our Cleaning Services

We quote per job, not per hour — as we get to know your property we naturally work faster, but your quality of clean never drops.

🏠

General Clean

Regular maintenance cleaning to keep your home fresh, tidy, and consistently spotless week after week. We use our own professional-grade products unless you prefer your own.

Regular Schedule Available
🔬

Deep Clean

A thorough, intensive clean reaching every corner, crevice, and surface. Perfect for spring cleans, pre-event preparation, or when a property needs a serious reset.

Most Popular
🏢

Commercial Clean

Professional commercial cleaning for offices, retail spaces, restaurants, and more. Flexible scheduling around your business hours with trained, insured staff.

Flexible Hours
🔑

End of Tenancy

Comprehensive end of tenancy cleans to meet landlord and agency standards. We're insured to handle keys — your property is in safe hands from start to finish.

Key Insured
🟫

Carpet Clean

Professional carpet cleaning to lift deep-set dirt, stains, and odours. We restore carpets to their best, using powerful equipment for outstanding results.

Specialist Equipment
